metadata.question: Were blooms of phytoplankton visible in the Norwegian Sea during June 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about phytoplankton blooms in the Norwegian Sea on June 5, 2019. Phytoplankton blooms are typically detected using ocean color sensors that measure chlorophyll-a concentration. The best dataset for this would be MODIS Ocean Color or VIIRS, but since this is a specific date, I should use a sensor that provides daily coverage. For phytoplankton detection: - Use MODIS Aqua Ocean Color (MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI) which has chlorophyll-a bands - Or Sentinel-3 OLCI which is specifically designed for ocean color - Look for elevated chlorophyll-a concentrations (>1 mg/m³ is often considered a bloom) I'll use MODIS Aqua Ocean Color since it has good historical coverage and is specifically designed for ocean monitoring. The Norwegian Sea is a large area, so I'll define a representative polygon covering the central Norwegian Sea. For June 5, 2019, I need to check if there's data available and if chlorophyll-a values indicate a bloom. Steps: 1. Define geometry for Norwegian Sea 2. Get MODIS Aqua Ocean Color data for that date 3. Check if collection has data 4. Extract chlorophyll-a values 5. Check if values indicate bloom conditions 6. Handle cases of no data or invalid results For validation: - Check if collection size > 0 - Check if valid pixels exist after masking - Check if chlorophyll values are reasonable (not NaN, within typical range 0-30 mg/m³) - Consider values > 1 mg/m³ as potential bloom conditions ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const norwegianSea = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-5, 65], [10, 65], [10, 75], [-5, 75], [-5, 65]] ]); const date = '2019-06-05'; const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aqua Ocean Color for chlorophyll-a let collection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(norwegianSea); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Aqua images on ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS Aqua data available for this date."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get chlorophyll-a band const image = collection.first(); const chlorophyll = image.select('chlor_a'); // Chlorophyll-a concentration // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount = chlorophyll.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: norwegianSea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('chlor_a').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid chlorophyll pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid chlorophyll data after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get chlorophyll statistics const stats = chlorophyll.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.percentile([90]), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: norwegianSea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanChlor = stats.get('chlor_a_mean').getInfo(); const p90Chlor = stats.get('chlor_a_p90').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean chlorophyll: ${meanChlor ? meanChlor.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`); console.log(`90th percentile: ${p90Chlor ? p90Chlor.toFixed(3) : 'null'} mg/m³`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanChlor === null || isNaN(meanChlor) || meanChlor < 0 || meanChlor > 30) { console.log("Invalid chlorophyll values detected."); console.log("C3"); } else if (p90Chlor > 1.0) { // Using 90th percentile > 1 mg/m³ as bloom indicator console.log("Phytoplankton bloom detected (90th percentile > 1 mg/m³)"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No significant phytoplankton bloom detected"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
